question:
Read the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aafb41adcf212ceaa47d643101b48bbf34b72702345a95cb2b8c8c7ff5ca3be1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3e36d60ec5af378f8bc94b92df80c4af56177e2cebd2c3227913dd849a298fd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d146c4aabbc6b2982267a164f7e0adcc53cb3f1c26e5ca5efc9d7da7fc184748.png]
solution: The logic followed here is: Logic: **Number in the circle = (Sum of the two numbers on the horizontal line) ÷ (Sum of the two number on slant line)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aafb41adcf212ceaa47d643101b48bbf34b72702345a95cb2b8c8c7ff5ca3be1.png] → 3 = (8 + 40) ÷ (12 + 4) → 3 = 48 ÷ 16
